summary: Galapagos (now Lakefront Biotherapeutics) filed a 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results, including a binding Framework Agreement with Gilead to facilitate Gilead's acquisition of Ouro Medicines, LLC for upfront consideration of $837.5M. The transaction is expected to close in Q2 2026. Galapagos is effectively a seller of its subsidiary Ouro to Gilead. Post-closing, Galapagos retains ~$2B cash (end-2026), with up to $500M for BD (including $150M for buybacks). A collaboration with Gilead advances T-cell engager gamgertamig. Watch for regulatory approvals and Q2 2026 close.
